headline: Trump's Mail-In Voting Order Blocked, DOJ Appeals to SCOTUS
summary: Election law experts track DOJ's appeal of the mail-in ballot TRO toward SCOTUS, while most other voices discuss unrelated legal stories.

clusters.name: Legal Analysis of Mail Ballot Case

voices.quote: I wrote about Judge Talwani’s decision, issued late Thursday, entering a Temporary Restraining Order that puts Trump’s Executive Order on voting by mail back on hold. And I assess how it will hold up
